## SEAM-101: Browser to REST API contract

What crosses: HTTP JSON calls from the annotator (`AnnotationIO.js`, `VideoList.js`, `labelBee.js`): `auth/login|logout|whoami`, `videos`, `video/<id>`, `annotations` (GET list, POST save), `annotation/<id>`, `rawdata/<path>`. Direction: browser to server, request/response. State owner: server database; session cookie. Proposed contract: one documented envelope, real HTTP statuses, `created_by` taken from the session, explicit boolean `all_users`, `created_from_id` stored; the client reads `data` only on 2xx. Current violations: failures returned with HTTP 200 ([BEH-129](view_cap-100-manage-data-users.md#beh-129-api-conventions-envelopes-status-codes-errors "API conventions: envelopes, status codes, errors"), [DEBT-106](view_debt.md#debt-106-inconsistent-envelopes-and-failures-returned-with-http-200 "Inconsistent envelopes and failures returned with HTTP 200")); client sends `created_by_id` ([DEBT-103](view_debt.md#debt-103-created_by_id-trusted-from-the-client "`created_by_id` trusted from the client")); client uses a nonexistent `rest/v2` route ([DEBT-118](view_debt.md#debt-118-tag-file-load-uses-a-nonexistent-route "Tag-file load uses a nonexistent route")); the client builds URLs through the global `url_for`/`http_script_name`.

## SEAM-102: Server pages to annotator (deep links and page parameters)

What crosses: the URL `/labelbee/gui` plus a hash `#video_id=<id>&video_data=<id>&frame=<n>`; Jinja variable `http_script_name`; links back from the annotator to `/videodata?videoid=<id>` and home. Direction: gallery to annotator (hash), annotator to gallery (links). State owner: the URL. Proposed contract: a small documented deep-link grammar (`video_id`, `video_data`, `frame`) shared by both sides; no server-side parameters. Current violations: the route reads `video_url` / `tag_file` and then ignores them ([DEBT-114](view_debt.md#debt-114-annotator-route-ignores-its-parameters-and-has-dead-code "Annotator route ignores its parameters and has dead code")); the hash grammar is duplicated as string concatenation in two gallery templates (`video_data_page.html`, `video_data_details_page.html`) and in `labelBee.js` `onhashchange`; the Info link has a server-side default (`gallery.videos_page`) that `VideoControl.js` overwrites with a hand-built `/videodata?videoid=` URL ([BEH-119](view_cap-100-manage-data-users.md#beh-119-annotator-page-route-and-deep-links "Annotator page route and deep links")).

## SEAM-103: Resources and pages to persistence layer

What crosses: calls `labelbee.database.*` (`dataset_list`, `get_video_by_id`, `video_data_list`, `add_video_data`, `edit_user`, ...), ORM objects, marshmallow schemas, direct `db.session` use. Direction: presentation to persistence. State owner: the database session (Flask-SQLAlchemy). Proposed contract: repositories return plain records or DTOs, own commits and rollbacks, never expose `db`; schemas live with the API. Current violations: `gallery.py`, `blueprints/auth/auth.py` (imports `db`, commits in `user_profile_page`), `resources/video.py` and `resources/annotations.py` import `db` and call `db.session.commit()` / `delete()` directly; `edit_user` swallows commit errors without rollback; the schemas import a module-level `ma` that is never initialised ([DEBT-122](view_debt.md#debt-122-two-marshmallow-objects-the-one-used-by-the-schemas-is-never-initialised "Two `Marshmallow` objects, the one used by the schemas is never initialised")); `models.py` mixes ORM models, WTForms and a user manager; `database/annotation/model.py` duplicates a model; circular import `app.py` / `models.py`.

## SEAM-104: File serving contract (`/data` and `/api/v1/rawdata`)

What crosses: URL path, `Range` header, `format` argument; response: file bytes (200/206), link-list HTML, or JSON listing `{files, dirs, base_uri, path, uri}` with `download_uri`. Direction: browser (`<video>`, file pickers) to server filesystem under `labelbee/blueprints/static/data` (the `/data` blueprint: `os.path.join(bp.root_path, "../static/data")`) or `$DATA_DIR` (`rawdata`). State owner: the filesystem. Proposed contract: one data root setting, authentication policy decided in [OQ-105](../../QUESTIONS.md#oq-105 "Which folder do `/data`, `$DATA_DIR` and `$ROOT_PATH` point to in deployments, and is `/data` meant to be public?"), a single Range implementation with standard error codes. Current violations: two roots for reading (`blueprints/static/data` vs `$DATA_DIR`) and a third for upload (`$ROOT_PATH`); the home and gallery pages assume `labelbee/static/data` ([OQ-105](../../QUESTIONS.md#oq-105 "Which folder do `/data`, `$DATA_DIR` and `$ROOT_PATH` point to in deployments, and is `/data` meant to be public?")); whether `/data/...` is answered by this blueprint or by the static rule (`static_url_path=""`) depends on Werkzeug rule ordering [inferred]; `rawdata` hides errors in HTTP 200 ([DEBT-106](view_debt.md#debt-106-inconsistent-envelopes-and-failures-returned-with-http-200 "Inconsistent envelopes and failures returned with HTTP 200")); Range bugs ([DEBT-116](view_debt.md#debt-116-download-and-range-handling-defects "Download and range handling defects")).

## SEAM-105: Authentication, session and CSRF

What crosses: the session cookie, Flask-User pages (`user.login`, `user.logout`, ...), API login/logout/whoami, CSRF token (`X-CSRFToken`, `csrf_token` field, token returned by API login), `current_user` role checks. Direction: browser to server, both ways. State owner: Flask-Login session on the server. Proposed contract: one login mechanism and one access-control decorator for pages and API; CSRF applied to cookie-authenticated API writes (or token auth). Current violations: two parallel login paths (Flask-User form and `/auth/login`); API blueprint exempt from CSRF ([DEBT-107](view_debt.md#debt-107-security-hygiene-csrf-exemption-secrets-in-log-committed-credential "Security hygiene: CSRF exemption, secrets in log, committed credential")); role checks inline per method ([BEH-105](view_cap-100-manage-data-users.md#beh-105-page-access-control-login-and-role-checks "Page access control (login and role checks)")); inactive user handling ([DEBT-121](view_debt.md#debt-121-api-login-reports-success-for-inactive-users "API login reports SUCCESS for inactive users")).

## SEAM-201: FrameSync API (seek in, presentation out)

What crosses: requests `seekFrame(frame)` (and `seekFrame(frame, "preview")` / `seekFrame(-1, "end-preview")` from the chronogram, `ChronoControl.js` `endPreview`), `forward/rewind(n)`, `delayedSeek(frame)`, `pause()`, `getCurrentFrame()`; the event `frame:changed` (jQuery, on the VideoControl object) plus direct calls `overlay.hardRefresh()` and `videoControl.onFrameChanged()` from `AnnotationIO.js` after data loads; the router fields `removeHashOnFrameChange`, `removeHashOnFrameChangeFrame`.
Direction: views and key handlers -> FrameSync (requests); FrameSync -> views (presentation). State owner: `VideoControl.currentFrame` (written only by the mode-specific `onFrameChanged*` callbacks).
Proposed contract: `seek(frameId) -> token`, one `presented({frame, token, mode})` event after the image is actually displayed; views never read private fields; `refresh()` re-presents the current frame without seeking; stale completions dropped by token (README 9.1); preview is an explicit mode of the request, not a magic string.
Current violations: `OverlayControl.optsClick` writes `videoControl.currentMode` [read]; `AnnotationIO.js` calls `videoControl.onFrameChanged()` as a redraw [read]; `ChronoControl.js` reads `videoControl.currentFrame` directly (the 'auto' focus interval, `currentFrame +/- 500`) [read]; `VideoControl.refresh` calls `overlay.hardRefresh()` directly instead of only emitting the event [round 1]; `SelectionControl.js` calls `videoControl.refresh()` for redraws [round 1]; the router writes `removeHashOnFrameChange*` on the VideoControl [read].

## SEAM-202: Frame image source (what the overlay draws)

What crosses: `videoControl.video` (HTMLVideoElement) in mode `video`, `videoControl.currentImage` (Image) in modes `cache`/`cache-preview`, `videoControl.previewVideo` in dead mode `preview`, `videoControl.flagCopyVideoToCanvas`; the frame-source geometry has two consumers: `onVideoSizeChanged -> overlay.canvasSetVideoSize(w,h)` (push at load and at load error, read in `VideoControl.js`) and `videoControl.videoSize()` (pull, called by `updateROIFromVideo` for the ROI "Reinit" button in `OverlayControl.js`) [read]; `overlay.videoSize` {w,h} is read back by `optsClick('fixedAspect')` [read].
Direction: VideoControl -> OverlayControl/ZoomView (pull at redraw; push of the size at load). Owner: VideoControl.
Proposed contract: `FrameBackend.getPresented() -> {frame, bitmap|element, width, height, exact}` and one `size` property/event; the overlay never branches on `currentMode`.
Current violations: `OverlayControl.js` redraw and `ZoomView.js` (two places) branch on `videoControl.currentMode` [round 1]; `ZoomView.js` reads `videoControl.video.src` [round 1]; `OverlayControl.js` passes `videoControl.video.src` and hard-coded fps 20 to `videoCache` [round 1]; `VideoControl.onVideoSizeChanged` calls the global `overlay` directly [read].

## SEAM-203: VideoCache interface

What crosses: `getFrameImageAsync(url, frame, fps)`, `getFrameImageSync`, `getFrameState`, `getFrameCropDataURL(url, frame, fps, crop)`, `preloadFrames`, `enqueueFrame`, `processQueue`, `cancelQueue`, `resetCache`, `#cache-status` and `#videoCacheSize` DOM ids.
Direction: OverlayControl (Image Diff, tag thumbnails, export frame), ZoomView and VideoControl -> VideoCache. Owner: VideoCache (LRU map, queue, hidden video).
Proposed contract: promise-based `getFrame(videoId, frame) -> ImageBitmap` with cancel token (cancel rejects pending promises, [DEBT-210](view_debt.md#debt-210-videocache-queue-defects "VideoCache queue defects")); crop helper separate; no DOM writes inside the cache (status via event).
Current violations: callers reach the global `videoCache` (assigned in the VideoControl constructor) [round 1], pass raw URL strings and guessed fps (`20`) [round 1]; `processQueue` and `updateStatus` write `#cache-status` directly [round 1]; `onVideoCacheParamsChanged` reads the DOM [round 1]; `cancelQueue` and `processQueue` share `processingQueue` and `queryQueue` without ownership of the in-flight item ([DEBT-210](view_debt.md#debt-210-videocache-queue-defects "VideoCache queue defects") g) [inferred].

## SEAM-204: Key map

What crosses: key events from the page; effect calls into other modules: `deleteSelected` (SelectionControl), `labelsProcessKey` (SelectionControl), `videoControl.*` (stepping, play, refresh), `overlay.getActiveObject`, `submit_bee`, `changeObservationID`, `storeObs`, `updateObsLabel`, `refreshChronogram`.
Direction: KeyMap -> action modules. Owner: KeyMap (one table keyed by scope and gesture).
Proposed contract: `bind(scope, gesture, actionId)` with actions registered by their owner module; gestures include modifiers; the stepping table ([BEH-251](view_cap-200-load-play-video.md#beh-251-frame-stepping-keys-full-table "Frame stepping keys (full table)")) becomes data; label `accesskey`s registered from the label list.
Current violations: bindings spread over `labelBee.js` `onKeyDown` [read], `ZoomView.js` `ZoomOverlay.onKeyDown`, `ChronoAxes.js` (`keydown.trackFrame` on `body`), inline `onkeypress` attributes in the template, label button `accesskey` attributes, and fabric mouse handlers in `OverlayControl.js` [round 1 for all but `onKeyDown`]; `onKeyDown_IDEdit` and `onKeyDown_NewIDEdit` contain domain logic (submit, change ID, labels) [read].

## SEAM-301: Chronogram and the frame/selection owners

What crosses: reads of the current frame (`getCurrentFrame()`, events `frame:changed`, `previewframe:changed` from `videoControl`), reads of `overlay.trackWindow` and event `trackWindow:change`; requests: `videoControl.seekFrame(frame[, "preview"])`, `videoControl.pause()`, `selectBeeByID(id)`, writes `defaultSelectedBee`; selection events `tagselection:created/cleared` meant for `updateChronoSelection` (the subscription in `initChrono` is commented out; where it is bound was not seen). Direction: chronogram consumes frame and selection state, emits seek and select requests only. State owner: `VideoControl` (frame), `SelectionControl` (selected ID), `OverlayControl` (track window). Proposed contract: `FrameSource {currentFrame, onFrameChanged, requestSeek(frame, reason)}`, `SelectionPort {selectedId, onChanged, requestSelect(id)}`, `TrackWindowPort {backward, forward, onChanged}`. Current violations: chronogram writes the global `defaultSelectedBee` directly (`gotoEvent`, `gotoFrameId`); `initChrono` triggers `trackWindow:change` on the overlay from video events (reverse dependency); `focusTrackWindow` and the Follow state are in `OverlayControl.js` but manipulate `axes`; `SelectionControl.js` calls `axes.selectId`; `OverlayControl.js` reaches `refreshChronogram`/`updateChronoXDomainFromVideo`.

## SEAM-302: Chronogram and the derived data (CAP-802)

What crosses: arrays `allIntervals`, `flatTracks*`, `tagIntervals`, `chronogramData`, `allTagsID` (shared globals), entry `refreshChronogram()` / `updateChronoData()`, filter flags `flag_restrictID`, `restrictIDArray`, `flag_excludeID`, `flag_hideInvalid`, `flag_hideFlowers`, `chrono.config.frameFilter`, `chrono.config.idAxisMap`. Direction: data module produces, display and navigation consume. `updateChrono` (display) does not call `refreshChronogram`; the data pass is triggered by controls (`update_idAxisMap`, `setFrameFilter`, `onClickNextID`, `onAutoEventButtonClick`, filter handlers) and by other modules. The display mutates the data (`updateTagIntervals` called from `updateChrono`, in-place sorts in `find*`) and the data pipeline depends on view configuration (`y` precomputed with `chrono.config.idAxisMap` for events and in `updateTagIntervals`). State owner today: undeclared globals in `ChronoControl.js`. Proposed contract: `ChronoModel {intervals, tagIntervals, observationsList(filter), onChanged}` read-only for the view; `idAxisMap` applied in the view, not the pipeline. Current violations: [DEBT-305](view_debt.md#debt-305-redraw-and-layout-are-expensive-and-loop-prone "Redraw and layout are expensive and loop-prone"), [DEBT-306](view_debt.md#debt-306-id-axis-ordering-and-remap-fall-through "ID axis ordering and remap fall-through") (remap applied in `updateTagIntervals`), [DEBT-311](view_debt.md#debt-311-redraw-overwrites-labeledvirtual-tag-intervals "Redraw overwrites labeled/virtual tag intervals"), [DEBT-313](view_debt.md#debt-313-navigation-sorts-shared-arrays-in-place-and-mixes-id-types "Navigation sorts shared arrays in place and mixes id types"), and [DEBT-316](view_debt.md#debt-316-chronogram-file-writes-annotations "Chronogram file writes annotations") (the chronogram file writes `Tracks`: `augmentTrackWithTag`, `cleanObsoleteEvents`).

## SEAM-303: Chronogram view and its DOM page

What crosses: element ids `#svgVisualize`, `#chronoDiv`, `#chronoTab`, `#chronoStatusBar`, `#canvasresize`, `#labelingTab`, `#obsTable`, `#mousewheelMode`, `#showObsChrono`, `#showTagsChrono`, `#restrictID`..., `#cleanObsoleteEventsButton`, inline `onclick` handlers calling globals (`chronoAdjust`, `shiftTimeDomain`, `eventSeekModeClicked`, `cleanObsoleteEventsCB`, `chrono.setFrameFilter`...). Direction: page to code (handlers) and code to page (button `active` classes, text). Proposed contract: `ChronoView(container, options)` created with its container element and a command interface (`zoom`, `pan`, `setItemHeight`, `setSeekMode`); toolbar bound by a controller, not by inline `onclick`. Current violations: hard-coded selectors in constructors (TODO in `labelBee.js`); toggles for the same flag spread over class selectors (`updateButtons`), with the class-name mismatch of the "Show on Chrono" button (`buttonShowPartsOnChrono` vs `button_showPartsOnChrono`, [DEBT-315](view_debt.md#debt-315-show-on-chrono-button-is-outside-the-synchronisation-class "'Show on Chrono' button is outside the synchronisation class")); defaults carried by HTML attributes that mean the opposite (`checked="false"` on the Individual Events and Highlight checkboxes, correct only because `initChrono` resets them through `updateButtons_*`).

## SEAM-401: Overlay <-> VideoControl (frame refresh and frame source)

Crosses: `videoControl.refresh()` calls `overlay.hardRefresh()` on every frame change and after every edit; event `videosize:changed (w,h)` from `videoControl` to `overlay.canvasSetVideoSize`; the overlay reads `videoControl.currentMode`, `currentImage`, `video`, `previewVideo`, `isValidVideo`, `flagCopyVideoToCanvas`, `videoCache`, `currentFrame`, `getCurrentFrame`; it writes `videoControl.currentMode` (`optsClick`), calls `pause`, `seekFrame`, `refresh`, `hardRefresh`, `preloadFrames` and reads `videoinfo`. Owner of the current frame: `VideoControl`. Proposed contract: the overlay receives a presentation `{frame, image or video source, size}` and never writes the video mode; the display mode change goes through a `VideoControl` method; edits ask a `requestRedraw()` rather than `videoControl.refresh()`. Violations: `optsClick` writes `currentMode`; `redrawVideoFrame` reaches into the `<video>`/preview/cache objects; `exportFrame`, `redrawVideoFrameDiff` use `videoCache` directly.

## SEAM-402: Overlay boxes <-> SelectionControl (selection and commit)

Crosses: `overlay.getActiveObject/setActiveObject/canvas1` used by `SelectionControl.js` and `ZoomView.js`; the overlay calls `selectBee`, `selectBeeByID`, `selectBeeByIDandFrame`, `deselectBee`, `submit_bee`, `automatic_sub`, `updateForm`, `updateDeleteButton`, `updateUndoButton`, `getCurrentID`, `getSelectedRect`, `deleteSelected`; jQuery events `object:moving` / `object:modified` on `overlay` (consumed by `zoomOverlay.selectionChanged`) and `tagselection:*`, `selection:*` on `selectionControl`. State owners: committed data `Tracks` (Model); selected ID `defaultSelectedBee` (SelectionControl); selected box = Fabric active object (overlay). Proposed contract: overlay emits `boxSelected(id)`, `boxCleared()`, `boxGeometryChanged(id, geom)`, `boxCreated(geom, hints)`; a controller owns selection state and commits through a Model API (`storeObs`). Violations: selection state is split in three places (Fabric active object, `defaultSelectedBee`, `tagSelection`); `SelectionControl.js` removes Fabric objects directly; `onObjectModified` commits (calls `submit_bee` through `automatic_sub`) inside the overlay; `labelBee.js` (`onKeyDown_IDEdit`) changes `activeObject.id` directly and ignores the result of `submit_bee`, so a refused commit is reported as success ([DEBT-405](view_debt.md#debt-405-submit_bee-failures-are-silent-or-misreported "submit_bee failures are silent or misreported")).

## SEAM-403: View transform (canvas <-> video coordinates)

Crosses: `overlay.canvasToVideoPoint/Rect`, `videoToCanvasPoint/Rect`, `obsToCanvasRect`, `canvasTransformCenter/Scale/Pan/Set/Reset` used by `SelectionControl.js` (`updateForm`), `ZoomView.js`, the plotting functions and the mouse handlers; global `canvasTransform` array read directly by painting. Owner proposed: a `ViewTransform` object (pure, serializable `[sx,sy,tx,ty]`, clamped by `canvasSize` and `videoSize`) with no refresh side effect. Violations: transform mutation methods call `hardRefresh`; consumers read the global array (`redrawVideoFrame*`, `onMouseDown_panning`, `updateDefaultSizeFromRect`); the transform maps canvas pixels while the data are in video pixels (INV on frame resolution coordinates).

## SEAM-404: Interaction modes and widgets (group 6 boundary)

Crosses: `overlay.interaction`, `setInteractionMode`, `refreshInteraction`; `hardRefresh` building the pick-frame panel; `onMouseDown` dispatch in `edit-visit`; `onObjectSelected` calling `visitWidget.selectVisit`; `VisitWidget`/`TimelineWidget` calling back `overlay.getActiveObject`, `overlay.interaction`, `hardRefresh`; `SelectionControl.modifyCurrentObsSpan('setspan')` entering `pick-frame` (it reads the chronogram global `flatTracksAll`); the pick-frame panel calling `gotoEvent`, `refreshChronogram` and `drawTimelinePickFrameMode`; `drawTimelineCurrentObject` button. Owner proposed: an `InteractionMode` controller (main, pick-frame, edit-visit) with a small strategy interface `onBoxClicked(obs)`, `onBackgroundClicked()`, `renderPanel()`; the overlay only asks it before handling a mouse event. Violations: the widgets live in the overlay file and use its internals; the panel DOM is built in `hardRefresh`; `hardRefresh` writes `span` into `Tracks`; the dispatch of `onMouseDown` mixes the mode checks with the click modes ([BEH-457](view_cap-400-overlay-display-annotations.md#beh-457-mouse-down-dispatch-order "Mouse-down dispatch order")).

## SEAM-405: Track window shared with the chronogram

Crosses: `overlay.trackWindow` read by `ChronoControl.js` (`getWindow`, `updateTrackWindowSpan`), `ChronoControlInteraction.js` (`onAxesDblClick`); jQuery event `trackWindow:change` on `overlay` consumed by the chronogram and by the "Follow" binding (`focusTrackWindow` writes `axes.xdomainFocus`); `onClickFocusVideo` calls `updateChronoXDomainFromVideo`; `labelBee.js` `init` calls `onTrackWindowChanged`. Owner proposed: a `TrackWindow` model (`{backward, forward}`, current frame) with a change event; chronogram and overlay subscribe. Violations: `focusTrackWindow` is documented in code as "actually a Chronogram method" but lives in the overlay file; chronogram reads `overlay.trackWindow` directly; `getWindow` is in `ChronoControl.js` yet used by overlay and `SelectionControl.js` (`getIdsInFocus`).

## SEAM-406: Tag filters and display flags shared with the chronogram

Crosses: implicit global functions `tagsSampleFilter` (and parts), `tagsIntervalFilter`, `tagsIDFilter`, flags `flag_useROI`, `ROI`, `excludeRects`, `showTagsChrono`, `showObsChrono`, called/read by `ChronoControl.js`, `ChronoControlActivitiesLegacy.js` and the HTML handlers (`chronoFilter`, `onTagsParametersChanged`, `onChronoParametersChanged`); filters rebuilt from DOM inputs by `refreshTagsParameters`. Owner proposed: a `TagFilter` module ([CAP-801](view_capabilities.md#cap-801-filters "Filters")) with an immutable filter config and `apply(tag)`, serialised from the form; the overlay and chronogram get the config. Violations: filter state in globals, built from DOM text via `Function()`, defined in the overlay file; both views trigger each other's refresh (`refreshChronogram` + `videoControl.refresh`).

## SEAM-407: Skeleton drawing on boxes (group 5 boundary)

Crosses: `fabric.BeeRect._render` reads `zoomOverlay.flagShowParts` and `zoomOverlay.labelList` (colors), and `obs.parts` (`{label, posFrame}` in video pixels); the zoom view writes `parts` into the active box's observation. Owner proposed: skeleton keypoint data + templates ([OQ-007](../../QUESTIONS.md#oq-007 "Skeleton labeling")) owned by the skeleton module; the overlay receives a `renderSkeleton(ctx, obs, transform)` function or a list of drawable points. Violations: the overlay reaches into the zoom view's global object for both flag and palette.

## SEAM-501: Zoom view and selection/overlay/key handling

What crosses: the selection events from `selectionControl` and `overlay` (`selection:*`, `tagselection:*`, `object:moving`, `object:modified`) into `ZoomOverlay.selectionChanged`; reads of the active overlay rect (`overlay.getActiveObject`), `getCurrentTag`, `getCurrentID`; reads of the video element and `videoControl.currentImage`; writes of `obs.parts` followed by `automatic_sub`; keyboard events from `#videozoom` (handled by `ZoomOverlay.onKeyDown`, bound on `#videozoom`, inside `#right-side`) versus the global key handler (bound on `#left-side`).
Direction: events in, reads of shared selection; parts out to `Tracks` through the store.
State owner: selection is owned by selection/overlay modules; zoom owns the view state and the markers (until synced).
Proposed contract: `zoom.setTarget({obsRef, tag, frame})` called by one coordinator on selection or frame change (no event binding to private overlay events); `zoom.onPartsChanged(parts)` callback that the store handles (update + refresh); a key manager ([DEC-005](view_decisions.md#dec-005-keyboard-shortcuts-belong-in-one-place "Keyboard shortcuts belong in one place")) routes keys by focus scope.
Current violations: `labelBee.js` binds zoom handlers; `ZoomView.js` reads `overlay`, `videoControl`, `Tracks`, `Tags`, `flatTracksAll` directly; `OverlayControl.js` reads `zoomOverlay.flagShowParts` and `labelList` to draw parts; the key maps are split over two handlers with no shared map ([DEC-005](view_decisions.md#dec-005-keyboard-shortcuts-belong-in-one-place "Keyboard shortcuts belong in one place")). The two key handlers are disjoint by DOM scope (`#videozoom` is in `#right-side`, the global handler is on `#left-side`): zoom keys never reach the global handler, and frame and label keys are dead while the focus is in the zoom panel ([OQ-501](../../QUESTIONS.md#oq-501 "Keys inside the zoom view and the global key map")).

## SEAM-502: Tag fix pipeline and annotation data

What crosses: `obs.fix`, `obs.newid` and the `wrongid`/`falsealarm` labels (observation side), `tag.fix`, `tag.p`, `tag.id` (Tags side), clean-up deletions of `Tags` and `Tracks`; refresh of the chronogram, form and video.
Direction: zoom UI -> data model -> chronogram/overlay.
State owner: data model (`Tracks`, `Tags`); the zoom UI holds none.
Proposed contract: `TagFix.apply(obsRef, {newid, tagangle})`, `TagFix.clear(obsRef)`, `TagFix.bakeAll()`, `TagFix.undoAll()` operating on the model with a change event; UI listens to the event instead of calling `refreshChronogram`/`updateForm`.
Current violations: `ZoomView.js` mutates `Tags` and `Tracks` directly, adds labels via `updateObsLabel`, calls `refreshChronogram`, `updateForm`, `updateRectObsActivity`, `automatic_sub`; clean-up buttons of another panel call `zoomOverlay.*`; `getCoveredTags` writes `obs.span`. Shared reference hidden behind the "data model owns Tags/Tracks" contract: `augmentTrackWithTag` sets `Tracks[F][id].tag` to the same object as `Tags[F].tags[i]` (run by `updateChronoData`), so editing a `Tags` entry edits `obs.tag`; `deleteFalsealarmTags` turns `Tags[F].tags` into an object, which `augmentTrackWithTag` (`.length` loop) then skips ([DEBT-520](view_debt.md#debt-520-deletefalsealarmtags-changes-the-container-type-of-tagsftags "deleteFalsealarmTags changes the container type of Tags[F].tags")). The global `tagMode` (`OverlayControl.js:5`, constant `'Tracks'`) selects which of two tag sources `getTag` reads ([OQ-505](../../QUESTIONS.md#oq-505 "Tags-only tag mode")).

## SEAM-503: Tag code tables and tag images (static data)

What crosses: GET of `/data/tags/tag25h5inv/tag25h5_bin.json`, `.../tag25h5_hamming_matrix_5-6.json` and `.../png/keyed<NNNN>.png`; GET `/rest/config/keypointlabels/` (legacy route).
Direction: server -> client, read only.
State owner: server static data (location unknown, [OQ-508](../../QUESTIONS.md#oq-508 "Where are the tag code tables and tag images served from?")).
Proposed contract: a `TagFamily` object (`codes`, `imageUrl(id)`, `nearest(bits, maxH)`) loaded once, family chosen by project ([DEC-001](view_decisions.md#dec-001-tag-detection-and-bee-tracking-happen-outside-labelbee "Tag detection and bee tracking happen outside LabelBee"): other markings expected).
Current violations: URLs and family hard-coded in `ZoomView.js` (`initZoomView`, `loadTagCodesFromServer`, `loadTagHammingMatrix`); `tag25h5` 5x5 geometry hard-coded in `updateTagView` (`npix = 7`); the code-table load failure is console-only, so "From image" silently becomes empty.

## SEAM-601: Selection events and current-ID access

- What crosses: calls `selectBeeByID(id)`, `selectBeeByIDandFrame`, `deselectBee`, getters `getCurrentID`, `getSelectedID`, `getSelectedRect`; jQuery events on `selectionControl`; the global `defaultSelectedBee` read/written directly by ChronoControl, ChronoControlInteraction, OverlayControl and labelBee.js.
- Direction: views (chronogram, table, overlay, visit panel, zoom) request selection; SelectionModel notifies listeners (chronogram highlight, `#selectID`, form buttons, ZoomView).
- State owner: SelectionModel (current ID); the Fabric canvas holds the active rectangle but should be a view of it.
- Proposed contract: `select(id, frame?)`, `clear()`, `current(): {id, frame?}`; events `selection:changed` with payload `{id, rect?}`; no external write to the global.
- Violations: direct writes to `defaultSelectedBee` (`gotoEvent`, `gotoFrameId`, `onKeyDown_IDEdit`); `hardRefresh` re-selects by reading the global (or, in pick-frame mode, by the mode's `opts.id`); `selectBeeByID` also calls `axes.selectId` and `updateForm`; `getSelectedID` returns undefined when empty ([BEH-630](view_cap-600-labels-visits-stats.md#beh-630-two-notions-of-selection-current-id-and-active-rectangle "Two notions of selection: current ID and active rectangle")).

## SEAM-602: Observation commit (`storeObs`/`submit_bee`) and refresh fan-out

- What crosses: writes to `Tracks` are made by `storeObs` (a pure write: `copyObs` into the handle, no refresh), by `submit_bee` (calls `storeObs`, then `videoControl.refresh()` and `refreshChronogram()`), by `deleteEvent` (deletes, pushes the undo entry, then both refreshes), by `undoAction` (calls `storeObs`; refreshes in the same-frame path, seeks in the other-frame path), by `VisitWidget.newVisit` (`storeObs`, then `overlay.hardRefresh` and `refreshChronogram`), by `onKeyDown_NewIDEdit` (`storeObs` or `submit_bee`, then `overlay.hardRefresh` and `refreshChronogram`), and by span, swap-ID and pick-flower code, which poke `Tracks` and refresh themselves. `automatic_sub` writes nothing: it only dispatches to `submit_bee` (status `db`) or refreshes (status `new`).
- Direction: editors to model, model to views.
- State owner: the model (`Tracks`).
- Proposed contract: a single `commit(change)` that updates the store and emits `annotations:changed`; views subscribe (overlay, chronogram, table, statistics). It replaces the call sites above, each of which currently picks its own refresh set.
- Violations: editors call `videoControl.refresh`, `overlay.hardRefresh`, `refreshChronogram`, `drawChrono`, `updateTagsLabels` directly; rectangle objects hold clones of observations (`rect.obs`), so form code edits the clone then submits; `hardRefresh` writes `span` into `Tracks` during a refresh (pick-frame mode); `drawImagePickFlowerMode` writes `obs.visit` into `Tracks` on open.

## SEAM-603: Form to observation (labels, notes, `bool_acts`)

- What crosses: `updateRectObsActivity` / `updateObsActivityFromForm` read DOM `#notes` and write `bool_acts`/`notes`; `setLabels` in OverlayControl.js; label helpers in SelectionControl.js are used by ChronoControl (`containsLabel`, `hasLabel`) and ZoomView (`automatic_sub`).
- Direction: LabelPanel to model; chronogram and clean-up read labels.
- State owner: LabelModel (vocabulary) and the observation (`labels` string).
- Proposed contract: `LabelModel.has(obs,label)`, `.set(obs,label,on)`, `.parse/format`; DOM reading stays in the panel.
- Violations: label code lives in SelectionControl.js, form-sync code in OverlayControl.js, readers in ChronoControl.js; `bool_acts` readers in ChronoControl, OverlayControl, AnnotationIO; the label list is replaced by two loaders with different JSON keys (`labelListArray`, `labelButtonsArray`, [BEH-647](view_cap-600-labels-visits-stats.md#beh-647-preset-loads-a-label-list-from-the-server "'Preset...' loads a label list from the server")).

## SEAM-604: Interaction modes of the overlay (main, pick-frame, edit-visit)

This is the group 6 side of the boundary also listed as [SEAM-404](#seam-404-interaction-modes-and-widgets-group-6-boundary "Interaction modes and widgets (group 6 boundary)") (group 4 file, "group 6 boundary"); the two items describe the same seam, so [SEAM-404](#seam-404-interaction-modes-and-widgets-group-6-boundary "Interaction modes and widgets (group 6 boundary)") can be dropped in favour of this one.

- What crosses: `overlay.setInteractionMode(mode, opts)`, `overlay.interaction` (`mode`, `opts`), `refreshInteraction`, the mode-specific branches inside `onMouseDown` and `hardRefresh`; `modifyCurrentObsSpan('setspan')` (SelectionControl.js) and VisitWidget buttons enter the modes. Mode-scoped options live in `interaction.opts` (`showTimeline`, `showPickFlower`) while the timeline options (`timelineZoom`, `timelineDisplaySize`, `timelineMaxDelta`) live in `overlay.opts`.
- Direction: panels to overlay; overlay dispatches clicks to the active mode handler (`visitWidget.setPollinator/setFlower`).
- State owner: overlay (mode), widgets (their data).
- Proposed contract: modes as objects with `enter(opts)`, `onClick(target)`, `render()`, `exit()` (exit clearing the mode's panel, which `setInteractionMode` does not do today).
- Violations: pick-frame panel built inside `hardRefresh`; `onMouseDown` hard-codes the edit-visit logic; widgets use global `selectBeeByIDandFrame`, `deleteEvent`, `videoControl`, `refreshChronogram`; the old panel is not cleared when the mode ends ([BEH-645](view_cap-600-labels-visits-stats.md#beh-645-pick-frame-panel-set-startend-goto-close "Pick-frame panel: Set Start/End, Goto, CLOSE")); the state table of the group 6 section of modules.md was extended with the rows these options need (frag2-6-modules.md).

## SEAM-701: AnnotationStore interface (model vs views)

What crosses: reads (`getObsHandle`, `obsDoesExist`, `getValidIDsForFrame(s)`, iteration over `Tracks`) and writes (`storeObs`, rename, delete, bulk delete from clean-up) from Overlay, Selection, Chrono, Zoom; wholesale replace from IO (`setTracks`, `setTags`); derived runtime fields (`obs.tag`, `obs.span`). Direction: views to store (calls), store to views by explicit refresh calls (`videoControl.onFrameChanged`, `refreshChronogram`). State owner: `AnnotationStore` (today the bare globals). Proposed contract: `replace(tracks, info)` / `replaceTags(tags, info)` emit one `annotations:changed` event; `get/put/delete/rename(frame,id)`; no direct `Tracks[f][id] = ...` or `delete` outside the store; runtime fields (tag, span) kept in side maps. Current violations [read]: `labelbee/static/labelbee/js/SelectionControl.js:663` (`deleteEvent` runs `delete Tracks[frame][id]`); `labelbee/static/labelbee/js/SelectionControl.js:985-1017` (`modifyCurrentObsSpan` takes `obs = Tracks[frame][id]`, the stored observation, and writes `obs.span`); `labelbee/static/labelbee/js/ChronoControl.js:1021` (`augmentTrackWithTag`, called from `updateChronoData:965` at every refresh, writes `obs.tag` on stored observations); `labelbee/static/labelbee/js/OverlayControl.js` (`addRect` builds `new Observation(id)` outside the store, and the visit creation builds a `tmpObs` for `storeObs`); `labelbee/static/labelbee/js/SelectionControl.js:6` (global `undo = new Observation(0)`); [inferred, earlier read] `ChronoControl.js` and `ZoomView.js` clean-up code deletes from `Tracks`; `setTracks` forces the refresh itself and does not clear undo/selection.

  - [labelbee/static/labelbee/js/AnnotationIO.js](../../../labelbee/static/labelbee/js/AnnotationIO.js): `setTracks`, `setTags`

## SEAM-702: Codec boundary (pure serialization)

What crosses: store snapshot <-> JSON/CSV text and objects. Direction: `LocalFileIO`/`ServerAnnotationClient` call the codec with parsed JSON or text; codec returns `{info, data}` or text. State owner: none (pure). Proposed contract: `encodeEvents(snapshot, videoinfo, info) -> {info, data}` without mutating inputs (fixes [DEBT-706](view_debt.md#debt-706-v2-save-mutates-tracksinfo-and-crashes-when-history-is-a-string "v2 save mutates TracksInfo and crashes when history is a string"), [DEBT-707](view_debt.md#debt-707-c1-converttrackstov1-mutates-live-tracks "C1, convertTracksToV1 mutates live Tracks")); `decodeEvents(obj, {normalizeLabels}) -> {ok, info, data, warnings[]}` instead of alerts/console; `decodeTags`, `encodeTags`; CSV importers table-driven with the `cb` producer constants as parameters ([OQ-708](../../QUESTIONS.md#oq-708 "Fixed 300x600 box and +90 angle in CSV imports")). The label vocabulary is not owned by the codec: `sanitizeEvents` calls `hasLabel` (`labelbee/static/labelbee/js/SelectionControl.js:855`), which uses `containsLabel`, `toLabelArray` and `normalizeLabel` (the alias map, same file around lines 795-860) and mutates `obs.labels` to `""` when null. Proposed owner: the labels module of group 6 ([CAP-601](view_capabilities.md#cap-601-behavior-labels-and-notes "Behavior labels and notes"), [DEC-003](view_decisions.md#dec-003-labels-are-generic "Labels are generic")) exports a pure `normalizeLabels(str)` / `hasLabel` that the codec receives as a dependency, so the codec stays pure. Current violations [read]: `convertTracksTo*` read the globals `Tracks`, `TracksInfo`, `videoinfo`; `sanitizeEvents` calls `alert` and `hasLabel` from `SelectionControl.js`; `setTracks` couples decoding, store write and view refresh.

## SEAM-801: Pipeline entry (store + filters -> derived data)

What crosses: call `computeDerived(Tracks, Tags, filters, {showEvents, showTags})` returning `DerivedData = {chronogramRows, intervals, crosses, partsIntervals, flat: {all, valid, groupAll, groupValid, view}, flatTags, ttags, tagIds, tagIntervals}` ([BEH-801](view_cap-800-filtering-processing.md#beh-801-refresh-pipeline-order-and-what-each-stage-reads "Refresh pipeline order and what each stage reads")). Direction: views call it, it returns data. State owner: a derived-data holder in the chronogram controller (replaces the globals of the table); it recomputes on events `tracks:changed`, `tags:changed`, `filters:changed`. Contract: deterministic, no side effects, no DOM, ordering rules of [BEH-803](view_cap-800-filtering-processing.md#beh-803-flat-track-lists-updateflattracks "Flat track lists (updateFlatTracks)")/[BEH-812](view_cap-800-filtering-processing.md#beh-812-tag-detections-to-tag-intervals-updatetagintervals "Tag detections to tag intervals (updateTagIntervals)") are part of the output. Current violations: the stages communicate through ~20 implicit globals ([DEBT-803](view_debt.md#debt-803-implicit-globals-and-shared-mutable-products "Implicit globals and shared mutable products")); `showObsChrono=false` leaves stale products ([DEBT-801](view_debt.md#debt-801-stale-intervals-when-show-events-is-off "Stale intervals when 'Show Events' is off")); AnnotationIO `setTags` calls `getTTags` in the middle of the load, before the `refreshChronogram` that ends `setTags` ([BEH-811](view_cap-800-filtering-processing.md#beh-811-tag-series-per-id-getttags "Tag series per ID (getTTags)")).

## SEAM-802: Tracks/Tags to derived join (tag integration)

What crosses: read-only access to `Tracks` and `Tags`; a lookup `tagFor(frame, id)` replacing `obs.tag`. Direction: store to pipeline. State owner: the model (`Model.js` / future store); the join is owned by `derive/flatten.js`. Contract: no write to `Tracks`; `tagFor` matches `String(tag.id) == bee id` in the same frame; no filter applied. Current violations: `augmentTrackWithTag` writes `obs.tag` and `updateChronogramData` writes `obs.cx/cy` ([DEBT-802](view_debt.md#debt-802-read-path-mutates-tracks-obstag-never-cleared "Read path mutates Tracks (obs.tag never cleared)"), [DEBT-804](view_debt.md#debt-804-obscxcy-written-by-the-read-path-bool_acts-used-for-activity "obs.cx/cy written by the read path, bool_acts used for activity")); `OverlayControl.getTag` and `cleanObsoleteEvents` read `obs.tag` set by a Chrono function; `Model.cacheTags` reads the Chrono global `ttags` ([DEBT-823](view_debt.md#debt-823-computemotiondirection-discards-its-result-cachetags-wrong-key "computeMotionDirection discards its result; cacheTags wrong key")).

## SEAM-803: Derived data to consumers (views and navigation)

What crosses: read-only `DerivedData` fields: `flat.*` to event navigation (`ChronoControlInteraction.js`), `SelectionControl.js` (~line 987) and `ZoomView.js` (~line 1840); `intervals`, `crosses`, `partsIntervals`, `tagIntervals` to the chronogram renderers ([CAP-300](view_capabilities.md#cap-300-temporal-display-and-navigation "Temporal display and navigation")); `ttags` to tag tracks in the overlay ([CAP-304](view_capabilities.md#cap-304-tag-display "Tag display")). Current violations: `CCI` sorts `flatTracksAll`/`flatTracksValid`/`...GroupById` in place, and in auto event mode sorts the global `tagIntervals` itself (`tagList = tagIntervals`, [DEBT-803](view_debt.md#debt-803-implicit-globals-and-shared-mutable-products "Implicit globals and shared mutable products")); consumers read implicit globals by name; `renderTagIntervals` in the legacy file and `ChronoIntervals` both read the globals ([DEBT-803](view_debt.md#debt-803-implicit-globals-and-shared-mutable-products "Implicit globals and shared mutable products")).

What crosses: the `Filters` plain object (restrict, exclude, hideInvalid, hideFlowers, frameRange, idAxisMap) written by the filter buttons in the chronogram area ([CAP-801](view_capabilities.md#cap-801-filters "Filters")) and read by the pipeline and by event navigation (`flag_hideInvalid` read directly by [CAP-305](view_capabilities.md#cap-305-event-navigation "Event navigation") code today). ## SEAM-805: Tag filter panel (OverlayControl) to pipeline

What crosses: the tag filter settings (Hamming mode, min DM, RGB flag, ROI + flag, exclude rects + flag, three expression strings, min length) as part of `Filters.tag`; compiled predicates `sample(tag)` and `interval(interval)` handed to the tag stages; `tagsHaveDM` as a capability flag from the tag loader. Direction: panel to filters owner; pipeline reads. State owner: the filters owner ([SEAM-804](#seam-804-filter-state-ui-controls-to-filters-config "Filter state (UI controls to Filters config)")). Contract: predicates are pure functions of `(tag)` and `(interval)`; the overlay tag-track drawing receives the same compiled `sample`. Current violations: the predicates are mutable globals in `OverlayControl.js` that `ChronoControl.js` and the overlay both call; every callback (`ROIChanged`, `excludeRectsChanged`, `onTagsParametersChanged`) calls `refreshChronogram` and `videoControl.refresh` itself, and `ROIChanged` and `excludeRectsChanged` do so twice, once through `onTagsParametersChanged` and once directly ([BEH-827](view_cap-800-filtering-processing.md#beh-827-roi-filter "ROI filter"), [BEH-839](view_cap-800-filtering-processing.md#beh-839-exclude-regions-tag-filter "Exclude regions (tag filter)")); `AnnotationIO.setTags` writes `tagsHaveDM` ([DEBT-818](view_debt.md#debt-818-roi-filter-state-split-between-page-and-globals "ROI filter state split between page and globals"), [DEBT-819](view_debt.md#debt-819-user-javascript-filters-via-function-dead-tagsidfilter "User JavaScript filters via Function(), dead tagsIDFilter")). The "+" exclude-region button also reaches into `SelectionControl.js` (`deleteSelected`) and deletes the selected observation ([BEH-840](view_cap-800-filtering-processing.md#beh-840-exclude-region-from-the-selected-observation--deletes-the-observation "Exclude region from the selected observation (+) deletes the observation")).
